newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon gross reserves rise in end-Nov.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon gross reserves rise in end-Nov.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon's gross foreign exchange reserves rose $201.42 million in the second half of November to $5,767.45 million from $5,566.03 million, according to central bank figures.

According to the Bank's bi-monthly balance sheet issued on Tuesday, gross reserves had risen by $153.45 million in the first half of November. Gross reserves include commercial bank's foreign exchange deposits with the central bank.

The balance sheet did not give the bank's net reserves but banking sources said they stood at $3.8 billion. Net reserves were $2,858 million at the end of 1995 compared with $2,732 million at the end of 1994.
